title: lilium monadelphum subsp. armenum
intro: Lilium monadelphum subsp. armenum, commonly known as Armenian lily, is a species of lily native to the mountainous regions of Armenia. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Lilium monadelphum subsp. armenum include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce pain and fight off infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, antispasmodic, and antiseptic effects.
